documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited reported record quarterly performance for Q1 FY27, with consolidated revenues reaching Rs. 156 Cr and EBITDA exceeding Rs. 30 Cr. Management highlighted volume and revenue growth across various segments, capacity expansions in construction chemicals and polymer composites, and strategic international projects. The company also advanced its renewable energy integration, significantly increasing its green power share and lowering emissions.

guidance.claim: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve approximately 30% volume growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve ~30% volume growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The Polymer Composite & Masterbatch business is expected to contribute around 10% to FY27 revenue.
guidance.quote: This business vertical is expected to contribute around 10% to FY27 revenue.

guidance.claim: The contribution of the PCMB business to overall turnover is expected to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27, supported by strong business momentum.

guidance.claim: Management aims to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18% under Vision 2029.
guidance.quote: We aim to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18%.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall revenue to grow by 20% to 25% in FY27 compared to the previous year.
guidance.quote: What I can tell you on overall revenue is we are expecting about 20% to 25% growth in revenue in FY27 from the previous year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates some reduction in the infrastructure business during Q1 and Q2 due to lower bitumen availability.
demand_outlook.quote: One is we expect some reduction possibly in the infra business during Q1, Q2 of this year. And that is probably, it will be because of less availability of bitumen.

demand_outlook.claim: The industrial sector is experiencing very robust growth driven by high prices of virgin polymers.
demand_outlook.quote: However, we are seeing very robust growth in our industrial sector. That is driven by, due to these crisis, the benefit that we have seen is there is higher motivation for blending of rubber in bitumen as well as for use of recycled rubber materials in new products. It is driven by high prices of the virgin polymers.

demand_outlook.claim: The consumer segment continues to offer strong growth potential with India emerging as one of the fastest-growing markets globally.
demand_outlook.quote: The segment continued to offer strong growth potential with India emerging as one of the fastest-growing markets globally.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27, increasing the Company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed Rs. 27 Cr of capex in Q1 FY27 against the planned ~Rs. 100 Cr investment over FY27-FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: Completed Rs. 27 Cr. of capex in Q1 FY27 against the planned ~Rs. 100 Cr. investment over FY27–FY28.

capex_expansion.claim: Tinna Rubber incurred a capital expenditure of over INR100 crores during FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term growth strategy, we incurred capital expenditure of over INR100 crores during FY26.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has earmarked an additional INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: We remain committed to investing in the business and have earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and '28.

capex_expansion.claim: The polymer compounding facility capacity in Haryana is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with our expansion strategy, we are enhancing the capacity of our polymer compounding facility in Haryana, which is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The pyrolysis plant has commenced operations, while trial productions of the rCB plant are scheduled for Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: We are pleased to announce the successful commencement of operations of our pyrolysis plant and the rCB plant, which is under commissioning. The TPO production is expected to stabilize by the end of Q1 FY27, while trial productions of the rCB plant is scheduled to begin in Q2 FY27 and we expect both the plants to be in full operation by Q3 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: South Africa's Phase 2 full-scale tire recycling has been initiated with crumb rubber production expected by early Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, Phase 2 focused on full-scale tire recycling has been initiated with crumb rubber production expected to commence by early Q2 of FY '27.

margins_costs.claim: At the consolidated level, Q1FY27 EBITDA and PAT margins improved significantly by ~575 bps and 416 bps on YoY basis.
margins_costs.quote: At the consolidated level, Q1FY27 Revenues increased by 20%, and EBITDA & PAT margins improved significantly by ~575 bps and 416 bps on YoY basis.

margins_costs.claim: Renewable energy has contributed savings of INR 1.19 Cr for Q1FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Renewable energy (Solar Power) has contributed savings of INR 1.19 Cr for Q1FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA and PAT margins expanded by 286 bps and 161 bps respectively to 17.2% and 10% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: On a standalone basis, revenue remained largely stable at INR533 crores, while EBITDA and PAT margin expanded by 286 bps and 161 bps, respectively to 17.2% and 10%, reflecting our strong operational performance and sustained efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved by 206 bps to 17.1% for FY26.
margins_costs.quote: On a console basis, EBITDA margin improved by 206 bps to 17.1%, while revenue and PAT grew marginally by 8% and 9%, respectively.

margins_costs.claim: Nearly 50% of power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards.
margins_costs.quote: Nearly 50% of our power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards, supporting both our ESG objectives and cost efficiency efforts.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured a 15,000 MT rubberized bitumen processing order, scheduled for execution during FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Secured a 15,000 MT rubberized bitumen processing order, scheduled for execution during FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: Additional capacity of 12,000 TPA at Gannaur has been commissioned in Q1FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Additional capacity of 12,000 TPA at Gannaur (Sonipat), Haryana, has been commissioned in Q1FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: The company expanded its tire-crush capacity in India by 9% to 185,000 tons in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to strengthen our processing capabilities during FY26 and expanded our tire-crush capacity in India by 9% to 185,000 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The Varale plant has reached a capacity utilization of 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: The Varale plant, the newest of our plants, has now reached capacity utilization of 80%.

orders_capacity.claim: Tinna achieved all-time high tire processing volume in FY26 with capacity utilization remaining strong at 90% for India operations and 85% for Oman.
orders_capacity.quote: Tinna achieved all-time high tire processing volume in FY26 with capacity utilization remaining strong at 90% for India operation and 85% for Oman.

orders_capacity.claim: Tire crushing volumes increased by 13% in FY26 to 155,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Tire crushing volumes increased by 13% in FY26 to 155,000 tons per annum due to an increase in capacity and utilization.

capital_allocation.claim: Rs. 5 Cr. was allocated to R&D for FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs. 5 Cr. was allocated to R&D for FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR3.25 per equity share for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our commitment to delivering sustainable value to our shareholders, I am pleased to inform the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR3.25 per equity share for FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: Proceeds of approximately INR78 crores raised through a QIP in Q1 FY26 are now fully deployed.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q1 FY26, the company successfully raised approximately INR78 crores through a QIP, attracting participation from leading institutional investors like ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund, JM Financial Mutual Fund and Bank of India Mutual Fund. These proceeds are now fully deployed.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt declined by 10% to INR121 crores in FY26 from INR134 crores in the previous financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Balance sheet strength improved in FY26 with debt declining 10% to INR121 crores from INR134 crores in the previous financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow grew by 60% to INR57 crores during FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: The company generated healthy cash flow from operating activities, which grew by 60% to INR57 crores during the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Mbodla Investment Pty Ltd. and Tinna Rubber Arabia Ltd. reported a combined loss of Rs. 0.53 crore owing to initial start-up costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Mbodla Investment Pty Ltd. (South Africa) and Tinna Rubber Arabia Ltd. (Saudi Arabia) reported a combined loss of Rs. 0.53 crore owing to initial start-up costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management has prudently revised the project implementation timeline in Saudi Arabia in light of evolving geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia.
risks_headwinds.quote: Management has prudently revised the project implementation timeline in light of evolving geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia and the GCC region, as ongoing supply chain and logistics disruptions continue to impact the broader industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: TP Buildtech's performance was impacted by currency fluctuation, crude oil volatility, and elevated polymer prices driven by the Middle East crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: TP Buildtech's performance was impacted by currency fluctuation, crude oil volatility and elevated polymer prices driven by the Middle East crisis.

risks_headwinds.claim: Oman plant performance was impacted by higher raw material costs and export disruptions from geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.
risks_headwinds.quote: Performance in Oman was impacted by higher raw material costs during the year and export disruptions arising from geopolitical tensions in Middle East during the last quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Capital works in Saudi Arabia were delayed due to Middle East tensions, with work expected to begin around the end of Q2 or Q3.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, due to the Middle East tensions, we thought it prudent to delay the commencement of the capital works and we are closely monitoring the situation. We expect to begin work possibly during end of Q2 or Q3 in Saudi Arabia.

risks_headwinds.claim: South Africa and Tinna Rubber Arabia reported combined losses due to start-up costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Mbodla Investments, South Africa and Tinna Rubber Arabia reported a combined loss of INR1.58 crores due to start-up costs.

management_commitments.claim: Recovered Carbon Black production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Recovered Carbon Black (rCB) production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27, followed by operational stabilization and commercial sales in Q4 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Transition of customers for steel abrasives distribution will start from Q4FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Transition of customers will start from Q4FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company has earmarked INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to investing in the business and have earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and '28. So over next 2 years, another INR100 crores of capex is foreseen by us.

management_commitments.claim: Nearly 50% of power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: Nearly 50% of our power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards, supporting both our ESG objectives and cost efficiency efforts.

management_commitments.claim: The contribution from the PCMB business is expected to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27, supported by strong business momentum.

management_commitments.claim: The polymer compounding facility in Haryana is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our expansion strategy, we are enhancing the capacity of our polymer compounding facility in Haryana, which is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
